After completing any task or fixing a bug, summarize the session into a new Markdown file in .claude_knowledge/log/.

Format: YYYY-MM-DD-task-name.md.

Content: What was the issue, what was the fix, and what should be remembered for next time (e.g., specific CUDA paths for RTX 3050 Ti).

Update the master file .claude_knowledge/knowledge_base.md with new patterns or rules discovered.
